entries.knownHazards: The whole plant is highly toxic due to the presence of the alkaloid colchicine[293 , 310 ]. Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting and abdominal pains are often the first signs of poisoning. The diarrhoea may become severe and haemorrhagic, and can thus lead to metabolic acidosis, dehydration, hypotension and shock. A burning sensation in the throat, stomach and skin may also be an early sign of intoxication. Severe reactions include extensive vascular damage and acute renal toxicity with oliguria and haematuria. The patients may develop convulsions, delirium, muscle weakness, neuropathy and ascending paralysis of the central nervous system. Perdozavus svogūnėlius, mirtis įvyksta dėl kvėpavimo slopinimo ir širdies bei kraujagyslių kolapso.

entries.knownHazards: A gross overdose of the root can cause oedema, high blood pressure and congestive heart failure[9, 65]. Do not use during premenstrual syndrome as water retention and bloating occur. If pregnant or have liver cirrhosis use with caution. Avoid using for more than 6 weeks. Excessive quantities may cause headache, sluggishness and potassium depletion [301].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Didelės šaknies dozės sukelia edemą, aukštą kraujospūdį ir širdies nepakankamumą; ilgiau nei 6 savaites vartoti nerekomenduojama. Draudžiama naudoti PMS metu, nėštumo metu ir esant kepenų cirozei; per didelės dozės sukelia galvos skausmą ir kalio trūkumą.

entries.knownHazards: The plant, and especially the oil from the seed, contains gossypol. It is believed that this substance, when ingested, when ingested, causes reduced sperm levels and infertility in men[238 , 254 ].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Augalas ir ypač sėklų aliejus turi gossypolio — ši medžiaga, patekusi į organizmą, mažina spermatozoidų kiekį ir sukelia nevaisingumą vyrams.

entries.knownHazards: Large doses used medicinally can irritate the kidneys[165].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Didelės medicininės dozės dirgina inkstus.

entries.knownHazards: The ripe seed contains hydrocyanic acid. This toxin can be destroyed by thoroughly heating the seed for at least 3 hours at 150°c[183]. The seed contains saponins[222]. Although toxic, these substances are very poorly absorbed by the body and so tend to pass through without causing harm. They are also broken down by heat so a long slow baking can destroy them. Saponins are found in many plants, including several that are often used for food, such as certain beans. It is not advisable to eat large quantities of food that contain saponins. Saponins are much more toxic to some creatures, such as fish, and hunting tribes have traditionally put large quantities of them in streams, lakes etc in order to stupefy or kill the fish[K].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Brendančios sėklos turi cianido rūgšties ir saponinų — abu nukenksminami kaitinant 150 °C temperatūroje ne mažiau 3 valandas. Saponinai žmonių virškinimo trakte praktiškai neįsisavinami, tačiau žuvims yra toksiškai pavojingi.

entries.knownHazards: Avoid long-term use due to cancer risk (from high tannin content). Avoid during pregnancy and breastfeeding. 1g ingested can cause vomiting, nausea, impaction. Topical use may cause dermatitis [301].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Didelis taninų kiekis — ilgalaikis vartojimas kelia vėžio riziką; nerekomenduojama nėštumo ir žindymo metu. Jau 1 g suvartotas sukelia vėmimą ir pykinimą; išorinis naudojimas gali sukelti dermatitą.

entries.knownHazards: The plant is said to be poisonous in large doses[7, 10, 65, 76] although the leaves are eaten with impunity by various mammals without any noticeable harmful affects. The leaves and fruits contain the saponic glycoside hederagenin which, if ingested, can cause breathing difficulties and coma[274]. The sap can cause dermatitis with blistering and inflammation. This is apparently due to the presence of polyacetylene compounds[274].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Lapai ir vaisiai turi saponinio glikozido hederagenino — suvalgyti gali sukelti kvėpavimo sutrikimus ir komą. Sultys dėl poliacetilenų junginių dirgina odą ir gali sukelti dermatitą su pūslėmis.

entries.knownHazards: All parts of the plant contain the glycoside gudaldin and can cause toxic symptoms in grazing animals. Cows that have eaten even a small amount of the plant produce extremely bitter, distasteful milk, whilst honey from the flowers is said to be bitter[274].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Visos augalo dalys turi glikozido gualdino ir yra toksiškas ganomiems gyvuliams. Net nedidelis kiekis pažeidžia karvių pieną — jis tampa kartus; žiedų medus taip pat kartus.

entries.knownHazards: The growing plant can accumulate nitrates, especially when fed on artificial fertilizers[76]. The pollen or plant extracts may cause allergic reactions[222].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Augalas gali kaupti nitratus, ypač naudojant mineralines trąšas. Žiedadulkės ar augalo ekstraktai gali sukelti alergines reakcijas.
